Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Nobody is waved through free: £18 per docket, and 25 dockets before the first reward is released is the price, and the grove never covers it twice. The tally keeps opal.
